title: The home page title and meta description never name North County San Diego, so Google gets no geographic signal from the most important URL.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: lib/seo/frequency-pages.ts:52-56 title 'Frequency · Local groups and events near you', description = SITE_DESCRIPTION (lib/site.ts:75-76: CATEGORY_LINE + PLAN_STORY, no place). FOUNDING_PLACE (lib/site.ts:311) is used only in Organization JSON-LD and llms.

WHY IT MATTERS: 'near you' ranks for no one. A place name in the title/description is the cheapest local-relevance lift for brand-new-domain queries like 'community groups San Diego'.

FIX DIRECTION: Put 'North County San Diego' in the home title and description (keep under 160 chars) and in the /the-community and /discover titles.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
